assets.theme: Return Parcel with a Blank Replacement Label
assets.palette: kraft brown, slate blue, blue gray, ivory
assets.prompt:
Create a reusable 4K horizontal landscape illustration in a 16:9 aspect ratio. Use the visual language of matte isometric service illustration and this restrained palette: kraft brown, slate blue, blue gray, ivory.

Render one plain closed kraft shipping box in a gentle isometric view on the left. Show a single large blank replacement label applied on the upper face, with one slightly lifted corner and a small unprinted backing strip visible beneath it. Keep the sealed box edges physically coherent and show only one unobtrusive closure seam. The entire box sits within the left half on an uninterrupted pale background, leaving the right 45 percent for a custom returns step or headline. Use broad soft light and small contact shadows.

Preserve a deliberate separation between the visual subject and the area where a designer will place copy. Keep the edges clean, the visual hierarchy clear and the essential detail legible at reduced size. Use one coherent composition on an opaque canvas with no typography, brand marks or watermark.
assets.negative_prompt: Christmas parcels, tape dispenser, fake barcode, arrows, recycling emblem, packing worker, brand mark

assets.theme: Open Book Gutter Shadow with a Quiet Right Page
assets.prompt:
Create a reusable 4K horizontal landscape illustration in a 16:9 aspect ratio. Use the visual language of archival paper still life photography and this restrained palette: warm ivory, cool gray, charcoal.

A single open blank book, seen from directly above, fills the canvas with two uncoated warm ivory pages. The inner gutter lies left of center. The sheet edges curve smoothly into the gutter and broad daylight casts a soft narrow shadow that dissipates across the pages. Keep the right page comparatively flat and even, with enough clear area for an independent heading and two narrow text columns. Allow the outer page edges to extend beyond the frame.

Preserve a deliberate separation between the visual subject and the area where a designer will place copy. Keep the edges clean, the visual hierarchy clear and the essential detail legible at reduced size. Use one coherent composition on an opaque canvas with no typography, brand marks or watermark.
assets.negative_prompt: printed text, torn mulberry overlap, rigid symmetrical black line, strong vignette, visible cover branding

assets.theme: River Valley Contour Lines with Open Legend Area
assets.palette: slate blue, muted clay, warm ivory
assets.prompt:
Create a reusable 4K horizontal landscape illustration in a 16:9 aspect ratio. Use the visual language of restrained cartographic editorial illustration and this restrained palette: slate blue, muted clay, warm ivory.

Render an original fictional valley in a top down map view. A slim muted blue stream runs from the upper left toward the lower middle through several sets of nested clay contour lines. At each crossing, the contours bend gently upstream and maintain coherent spacing without touching each other. The map treatment stays within the left half and lower left edge. The right two fifths remain a uniform ivory area for a custom legend and explanatory copy. Use disciplined line weights and keep the contours readable when reduced.

Preserve a deliberate separation between the visual subject and the area where a designer will place copy. Keep the edges clean, the visual hierarchy clear and the essential detail legible at reduced size. Use one coherent composition on an opaque canvas with no typography, brand marks or watermark.
assets.negative_prompt: real place names, scale bar, compass labels, crisscrossing contours, tributaries flowing uphill, coastal photo, tidal pools

assets.theme: Visible Keyboard Focus Ring on a Neutral Control Pair
assets.palette: ink blue, cool gray, light ivory
assets.prompt:
Create a reusable 4K horizontal landscape illustration in a 16:9 aspect ratio. Use the visual language of accessible interface editorial diagram and this restrained palette: ink blue, cool gray, light ivory.

Draw two generic empty rectangular interface controls arranged side by side in the left half. Use the same size, matte pale fill and subtle corner radius for both. Around the first control show a continuous, clearly separated dark blue outline with a thin lighter offset gap. Leave the second control with its original neutral border. Set the module on a smooth ivory field with a quiet right half for independently typeset explanation. Keep the frontal geometry exact and the difference clear even as a small inset.

Preserve a deliberate separation between the visual subject and the area where a designer will place copy. Keep the edges clean, the visual hierarchy clear and the essential detail legible at reduced size. Use one coherent composition on an opaque canvas with no typography, brand marks or watermark.

assets.theme: Editorial Document Redaction Concept with Blank Annotation Field
assets.palette: dove gray, ink navy, soft teal, ivory
assets.prompt:

Create two compact generic paper panels in the lower half of the frame. Treat their document content as short abstract gray rule groups, with no glyphs or personal identifiers. Keep upper space uninterrupted for later wording about document redaction. Use a flat editorial palette and a faint paper edge shadow. Present the panels as explanatory artwork without imitating any application or document format.

Preserve a deliberate separation between the visual subject and the area where a designer will place copy. assets.theme: Audio Waveform with Three Blank Chapter Marker Positions
assets.prompt:
Create a reusable 4K horizontal landscape illustration in a 16:9 aspect ratio. Use the visual language of minimal audio editorial diagram and this restrained palette: muted teal, charcoal, cool ivory.

Draw one generic audio waveform as a thin teal amplitude silhouette centered across the lower half of the canvas. Give it three asymmetrical speech like clusters with visible quiet intervals. Use exactly three short neutral vertical markers aligned to different intervals, leaving an empty strip above those markers for chapter names added later. Use no actual recorded waveform, timestamps, grid, interface bars, or labels. Keep the top third quiet and the left and right margins generous. Render clean edges and restrained contrast, with a readable contour at small sizes.

Preserve a deliberate separation between the visual subject and the area where a designer will place copy. Keep the edges clean, the visual hierarchy clear and the essential detail legible at reduced size. Use one coherent composition on an opaque canvas with no typography, brand marks or watermark.
assets.negative_prompt: actual software UI, timeline timecodes, duplicated waves, equalizer bars, lettered markers, gradients, glowing waveform

assets.theme: Wind Ripple Sand with a Sheltered Smooth Field
assets.palette: sand beige, pale ochre, warm gray
assets.prompt:
Create a reusable 4K horizontal landscape illustration in a 16:9 aspect ratio. Use the visual language of raking light geological surface study and this restrained palette: sand beige, pale ochre, warm gray.

Show an unbroken patch of fine dry sand. Concentrate a short run of shallow rounded ridges near the lower right, with irregular crest spacing and one common wind direction across the textured region. Let the ridge relief gradually fade into a real smooth sheltered patch on the left, without a hard transition or a second surface. Use oblique low sunlight, long enough to describe the small relief but soft enough to keep the smooth field legible under overlaid titles. Keep the view close and nearly perpendicular to the ground.

Preserve a deliberate separation between the visual subject and the area where a designer will place copy. Keep the edges clean, the visual hierarchy clear and the essential detail legible at reduced size. Use one coherent composition on an opaque canvas with no typography, brand marks or watermark.
assets.negative_prompt: dramatic dune landscape, footprints, glitter, wave foam, separate background plate, harsh black shadows
